UserSaveProfile.title: UserSaveProfile
UserSaveProfile.description: Single cloud save profile per Google-authenticated player storing lifetime OST accuracy stats and unlock progress.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the save owner.

displayName.description: Player display name from Google Sign-In.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

totalCorrect.description: Cumulative OST questions answered correctly across all games.

totalAttempted.description: Cumulative OST questions attempted across all games.

lastGameCorrect.description: Correct answers in the most recent recorded game.

lastGameAttempted.description: Attempted questions in the most recent recorded game.

lastGameRate.description: Accuracy percentage (0-100) of the most recent recorded game.

lastHeroId.description: ID of the last selected or played operative.

lastTopicId.description: ID of the last selected OST Playbook topic.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the save profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the save profile was last updated.

GameRunRecord.title: GameRunRecord
GameRunRecord.description: Immutable per-game accuracy and combat summary for a single run.

heroId.description: Operative ID played in this run.

topicTitle.description: Display label for the OST Playbook topic.

correct.description: OST questions answered correctly in this run.

attempted.description: OST questions attempted in this run.

correctRate.description: Correct rate percentage (0-100) for this run.

playedAt.description: Server timestamp when the run was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Private single cloud save profile keyed by authenticated user UID.

/users/{userId}/games/{gameId}.description: Private per-game run history tracking each session's correct rate.
